Add stream name uniqueness validation in the service layer before persisting to the database.
Leverage existing test frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Spring Boot Test) to achieve high coverage for StreamController at build time.

Develop a new Spring Cloud Stream source binder for Amazon Kinesis, including configuration, message conversion, and integration with the existing binder framework.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all implemented features, identify and fix any issues, and ensure all stories are working together.
Write or update documentation for the new features: extracted test fixtures, admin platform support, library registration, named channels, duplicate name prevention, and Kinesis module.
